newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian share trade down but index gains.
newsitem.headline: Estonian share trade down but index gains.

text.p: Trade on the Estonian share market was slightly lower on Friday but the key Tallinn stock exchange index gained a touch, the bourse said.
Overall volume was 1.6 million kroons, compared with 3.8 million kroons on Thursday. The index rose 0.05 percent to 97.99.
Dealers said the lower activity on the market was due to a lack of trading interest as investors headed into the weekend.
Shares in leading bank Hansa Bank were the most traded on volume of 800,000 kroons and it closed at 94.10 kroons, a slight drop from yesterday's 94.25 kroons.
The secondary free market had volume of more than 1.8 million kroons, climbing from yesterday's 937,062 kroons.
Plastics maker Norma was the most active on trade of 800,000 kroons but it slipped to 21.75 kroons from 22.10 kroons.
